title.en: Wage reference points: minimum wage, median and average earnings

basis: Statute (minimum wage), Destatis Verdiensterhebung (full-time employees), Anlage 1 SGB VI (pension-law average). Annual minimum-wage figure is derived* from an hours assumption.
assumptions: Annual minimum wage = hourly rate × 40 h × 52 weeks (marked derived*); a second figure uses Destatis' average paid full-time week (39.1 h, April 2025)
Median monthly × 12 ignores special payments (13th salary etc.); the annual series includes them, which is why annual median > 12 × monthly median

minimum_wage.annual_assumption: 40 h/week × 52 weeks = 2080 paid hours; collectively agreed full-time weeks are often 35-39 h, which gives a lower annual figure
